policies.title: ComCare Short-to-Medium Term Assistance

policies.title: SSO Hardship Fund (One-Time Help)

policies.title: ECDA Preschool Subsidy (Childcare and Infant Care)
policies.summary: Monthly subsidy on childcare and infant care fees at licensed centres. A basic subsidy for working mothers, plus an additional subsidy in income-based tiers: lower household income gets more help. Apply through the official preschool subsidy portal.

policies.title: Workfare Income Supplement (WIS) Payouts
policies.summary: Extra cash and CPF top-ups for lower-wage workers. Payouts are credited monthly, about two months after the month worked, once the employer has paid CPF for that month.

policies.title: Senior Household Top-Up (2025 version: $200 a quarter)
policies.summary: Quarterly cash top-up of $200 for senior households. Applies to applications made from 1 Jan 2025 to 30 Jun 2026. Replaced by the current version from 1 Jul 2026.

policies.title: Senior Household Top-Up (current version: $250 a quarter)
policies.summary: Quarterly cash top-up of $250 for senior households. Applies to applications made from 1 Jul 2026. Earlier applications follow the 2025 version.
